g.text: Runtime Phase: Enable/Disable Event, Write/Read to KVS
Acts as the transport layer, handling low-level IPC
and forwarding raw data between the client and server.
Client connections are established, and diagnostic jobs are initialized.
Initializes runtime environment for diagnostic jobs.
The server creates a ConfigSession to process
client commands and maintains the session for communication.
- Save or retrieve DLT configuration in persistent storage.
